label: Late original-phase steps (t>=4) after prefix containing r/3/l/o
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, at late positions (t=4..8, peak t=6; 92% of mass within the last 3 original tokens, to_go<=2); never on the delimiter, copy phase, or t<=2. Within that window it fires on only ~2-10% of steps, so position alone has very low precision (~8%, mass recall 0.91). Selectivity depends on the prefix content: rates rise when earlier inputs include r, 3, l, o (prev2_tok r/3/l lift 3-4x), and somewhat when the current input is 1. Requiring >=2 such tokens in the prefix gives dev F1 0.31 (P 0.21, R 0.61, mass recall 0.70); higher-activation steps are covered better (77% of top quartile). Activation is larger for longer sequences (L=8,9) and first-occurrence inputs. The remaining selectivity looks like a distributed hidden-state threshold not captured by a simple token rule.
